Also, he has checked my number there. But, I was not comfortable with that number. When I called him, he said it takes time for one to get used to progressive spectacles.
And before I realised 2 months went by and I never was comfortable. I kept squinting my eyes  while reading.
Finally after a year when I checked my number again , my actual number turned out to be higher. Which basically means that he has not recommended the correct vision no to me initially
Now, if i say something, he would say ' aapka number abhi change ho gaya '.
Net net .. it's just a so-so viral normal retailer who dupes by shortchanging on brand ( frame or lens) and also eye test irregularities.
Plus it's a real hassle to go all the way from suburbs to get something done on your specs( ask me..I wasted a year wanting to go there and unable to go there )....this not at all practical to go all the way to town from suburbs for a spectacle...
